name: cool8
description: A clean-sheet 8-bit CPU and the retro home computer around it. Node is here only to name and run the commands; every one of them is Python or the OSS CAD Suite underneath.

board.comment: The iCELink's USB vendor:product, used to find the board's serial port -- its COM number changes whenever the FPGA is reconfigured. Override with COOL8_BOARD_USB, or pass --port.

toolchain.comment: Where yosys, nextpnr, icepack, iverilog, vvp and icesprog live. Set the OSS_CAD_SUITE environment variable to the suite root, or put its bin on PATH. Never a path in the source: this differs per machine. `npm run doctor` says which tools were found and where.
